items.title: Implement the core main write lock primitive
items.context: Per session-ownership-and-write-leases.md Main Write Lock Rules 1-3 & 6: a global, atomic (mkdir-style), stale-reclaimable lock; lock scope covers the whole critical section; acquisition failure is blocking (no optimistic proceed). Reconcile storage with the existing .koala/runtime/done-main-merge.lock — decide and document migrate vs alias vs compatibility (the F-001 open decision), keeping story-lifecycle.md and session-ownership-and-write-leases.md synchronized.

happy.desc: main write lock 在 .koala/locks/main-write.lock/ 成功 acquire+release，mkdir-style 原子
全仓 rg 旧 .koala/runtime/done-main-merge.lock 路径 0 残留引用（除非测试证明的兼容 alias）

edge.desc: stale 锁（mtime 超时）被正确 reclaim
锁被持有时 acquire 失败返回 blocking 错误、不乐观放行

adversarial.desc: 两个并发 acquire 恰好一个成功，无双重持锁
story-lifecycle.md 与 session-ownership 文档锁路径一致，无两份真相源矛盾

items.userSees: 用户跑 koala validate 看到 main write lock 在 .koala/locks/main-write.lock/ 正常 acquire/release；rg 旧 .koala/runtime/done-main-merge.lock 路径 0 残留引用。

verificationEvidence.note: smoke section 1/1b acquires acquireMainWriteLock at .koala/locks/main-write.lock, asserts lock dir exists while held and removed after release; section 5 asserts canonical path constant

rg shows zero functional references to the old path in packages/main/src/; remaining matches are only explanatory comments documenting the retirement. done-effects.ts and done-recover.ts now route through acquireMainWriteLock at the new path
smoke section 3 backdates lock mtime past staleMs and asserts acquireMainWriteLock force-reclaims the stale lock; section 3b asserts a fresh held lock is NOT reclaimed and still blocks
smoke section 2+4 asserts a live held lock makes the second acquire throw a blocking error (failFastIfHeld) instead of optimistically proceeding
smoke section 2+4 asserts exactly one of two concurrent acquirers wins (secondAcquired stays false), no double-hold; the lock is re-acquirable only after the holder releases

story-lifecycle.md and session-ownership-and-write-leases.md both name .koala/locks/main-write.lock/ as the single canonical path; story-lifecycle.md cross-references session-ownership Storage node; the old conflicting runtime note in session-ownership was rewritten to state the retirement, removing the two-truth-source conflict

items.title: Hold the lock across the DONE critical section and fix F-008
items.context: DONE must hold the main write lock from the pre-merge final check through merge and worktree cleanup (rule 4). Fix B-META-framework-audit:F-008: the DONE flow currently writes a stale INIT_CHECK-era main-mirror story index.json before merge, then its own git merge aborts (partial-DONE). The fix must handle the stale main-mirror inside the lock — do not emit a stale mirror, or commit/reconcile it before merge — because serialization alone does not close F-008.

happy.desc: DONE 全程持 main write lock（pre-merge gate→merge→worktree cleanup 都在锁内）
正常单 session DONE 成功路径外部行为不变

edge.desc: F-008 复现场景：DONE 前 main 工作区有 INIT_CHECK 期未提交 index.json 镜像 → DONE 不再自阻塞、正常合并
INIT_CHECK 不再留下未提交的 main-side index.json 镜像

adversarial.desc: 两个并发 story_advance DONE 被锁串行化，无 partial-DONE race
post-merge 失败语义保持：story 已 DONE + 显式抛错

items.userSees: F-008 复现场景下 story_advance DONE 输出 '✓ 分支已合并 / ✓ Worktree 已清理 / ✓ 分支已删除'，而不是 'Story B-xxx 已标记为 DONE 但自动合并失败'。

verificationEvidence.note: DONE lock spans pre-merge gate→merge→worktree cleanup: acquired at transition-orchestrator.ts:222 inside the single try, released in the finally at :432 after applyDoneMergeEffects. assertDoneMainMergeLiveLockFailsBeforeMutation / assertDoneMainMergeLockBlocksBeforeAutoSyncMain prove the lock is held before any DONE mutation.

assertDoneSuccessPathOutputAndOrdering asserts the single-session DONE success path output (DONE Gate Checklist, advance line, merge/cleanup/branch-delete lines and Step ordering) is byte-identical; the F-008 fix only adds an INIT_CHECK commit, the DONE path is unchanged.

assertInitCheckLeavesNoUncommittedMainMirrorForDone replays the exact DONE Step-3 op (git merge story/<id> from main repo root) after the real INIT_CHECK CLI path; pre-fix this aborted on the untracked story-metadata mirror, post-fix it merges cleanly with no partial-DONE.

assertInitCheckLeavesNoUncommittedMainMirrorForDone asserts git status --porcelain for the story dir is empty after story_advance INIT_CHECK and the index.json is git-tracked — INIT_CHECK no longer leaves an uncommitted main-side mirror.

assertDoneMainMergeLiveLockFailsBeforeMutation: a live main-write lock makes a second concurrent story_advance DONE fail before phase=DONE is written (story stays TEST, branch/worktree untouched) — the lock serializes DONE, preventing a partial-DONE race.

assertRealMergeFailureMarksDoneAndThrows / assertWorktreeCleanupFailureMarksDoneMergedAndThrows: a post-writeStory merge or cleanup failure leaves the story DONE and throws with explicit manual-recovery guidance (cd/git merge/git worktree remove/git branch -d, or koala doctor) — post-merge failure semantics preserved.

items.title: Apply the lock + in-lock idempotency to shared-write commands
items.context: Apply the main write lock to gap_log / B-META finding writes / audit --framework / story_create / done_recover / main-mirror metadata writes (rule 5). Inside the lock, perform the doc's Idempotency Requirements: gap_log dedup by normalized title/category/source/evidence fingerprint; story_create dedup; finding mutations reject duplicate active findings; DONE recovery detects already-merged branches / already-removed worktrees.

happy.desc: gap_log / audit --framework / story_create / done_recover / B-META finding 写都在 main write lock 内

edge.desc: 并发 gap_log 同一 gap → 一条 canonical finding（dedup 生效）
并发 gap_log 不同 gap → 两条都保留，不被 fingerprint 误并

adversarial.desc: 锁竞争时第二个 shared-write 命令 blocking 失败，无静默覆盖
嵌套的 main-write 命令调用不自死锁

items.userSees: 并发 gap_log 同一框架 gap 后 finding_list 只列出一条 canonical finding；锁竞争时第二条 shared-write 命令看到 'main write lock is held by ...' 的 blocking 错误。

verificationEvidence.note: gap_log/story_create/audit/B-META finding 写均改用 withReentrantMainWriteLock 包临界区；done_recover 经 acquireDoneMainMergeLock(→acquireMainWriteLockRegistered) 持锁。lock smoke test 7/7c 覆盖 reentrant + registered acquire。
gap-log-8 + 8d：相同 gap 串行/并发(6 个真实子进程)登记都只产出一条 canonical finding，按 normalized desc+category+severity+evidence fingerprint dedup。
gap-log-8b + 8d：8 个仅在单一身份通道(desc/category/severity/sourceRefs/reproCommand/observedOutput/analysisNote)不同的 gap 各得唯一 fingerprint，不被误并；并发 4 个不同 gap 全部保留。
lock smoke test 2+4：live 锁被持有时第二个 acquire fail-fast 抛 blocking 错误，恰好一个 acquirer 成功，无双重持锁/静默覆盖。长临界区(DONE/audit)用默认 fail-fast；test 8 另证 wait 模式仍 stale-reclaim。
lock smoke test 7/7b/7c：嵌套 withReentrantMainWriteLock(同进程同 root)走 pass-through 不再 acquire，深度 3 不自死锁；DONE 持锁内调 audit(也持锁)经 reentrancy registry 透传，throw 后 registry 清空。

items.title: doctor stuck-lock check and lock-contention error UX
items.context: doctor detects stale/stuck main write locks and reports them. Lock-contention produces a clear blocking error message per the doc's Error UX 'main lock contention' example (holder session, running command, heartbeat age, retry guidance). Do NOT implement session_brief ownership rendering — that belongs to the owner-lease story.

happy.desc: lock-contention 错误消息含 holder session / 命令 / heartbeat age / 重试指引

edge.desc: doctor 检出 stale/stuck main write lock 并在输出中报告

adversarial.desc: doctor 不把正常持有中的活跃锁误报为 stuck
本 story 不引入 session_brief ownership rendering（范围约束，机械可查）

items.userSees: koala doctor 输出含 stale/stuck main write lock 报告行；锁竞争错误显示 'main write lock is held by session <id> running <command>, heartbeat <n>s ago. Retry after it completes.'

verificationEvidence.note: smoke section 2/3b asserts a fail-fast acquire against a live main write lock throws a holder-aware blocking error naming holder command, pid, hostname, heartbeat age, and a retry instruction; also asserts no fabricated sessionId token.

smoke section 4 backdates a held main write lock dir mtime past the 120s stale window and asserts scanMainWriteLock classifies it state=stuck and renderMainWriteLockScan emits a ⚠ STUCK report naming the holder; doctor.ts wires this scan into both text and json output.

smoke sections 5/5b assert a freshly-acquired lock and a 60s-old lock (both inside the 120s stale window) classify state=active and render an explicit "active operation, not stuck" report — doctor never misreports a live in-flight holder as stuck. Classification reuses the lock primitive MAIN_WRITE_LOCK_STALE_MS threshold.

CHK-004 diff touches only mkdir-lock.ts / main-write-lock.ts / main-write-lock-doctor.ts / doctor.ts / package.json + smoke; no session_brief handler is modified. The only sessionId mentions are doc comments that explicitly state sessionId is deliberately OUT of scope (owner-lease story). The contention message and holder.json record only mechanically observable pid/hostname/command/acquiredAt — no fabricated session identity and no session_brief ownership rendering introduced.

items.title: Multi-session regression smoke proving F-008 is closed
items.context: Smoke tests for multi-session lock behavior: two concurrent DONE operations serialize with no partial-DONE race; concurrent gap_log of the same issue dedups to one canonical finding; a stale lock is reclaimed. Critically, a regression assertion proving partial-DONE no longer arises from a stale main-mirror self-block (the exact F-008 scenario).

happy.desc: smoke 覆盖两个并发 DONE 串行化、无 partial-DONE

edge.desc: smoke 覆盖并发 gap_log dedup 与 stale-lock reclaim

adversarial.desc: F-008 回归断言：stale main-mirror 场景下 DONE 不自阻塞、正常完成
koala validate 全绿（含新增 multi-session smoke）

items.userSees: koala validate 输出含新增 multi-session lock smoke 全部 PASS，含 F-008 回归断言（partial-DONE 不再由 stale main-mirror 自阻塞产生）。
